A '''mobile battlegroup''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A mobile [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] was comprised of three [[repulsorlift regiment]]s, an [[armor regiment]], and [[battlegroup headquarters]]. It included 16,106 personnel, 1,342 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], and 265 [[Tank|heavy tanks]]. Mobile battlegroups were deployed to theatres where enemy territory was adjacent to loyalist [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] holdings, allowing the battlegroup to respond to enemy action and to make lightning raids.<ref name="ISB" />

Mobile battlegroups could be augmented by the addition of two more repulsorlift regiment, an [[artillery regiment]], and a [[armor regiment]].<ref name="ISB2" />
